all_GP.message:
The sinkhole repairs between Centurion and Irene are officially complete and safety tests are reportedly concluded.

​Full train service along the Pretoria – Irene / Kempton Park corridor is scheduled to resume on Monday, 17 August.

​Weekend Service (Until Monday):
​Trains from Pretoria will continue to terminate at Centurion.
​Trains from Kempton Park will continue to terminate at Irene.

​Next Train's will update the schedules as soon as they become live!

Safe travels!


- Next Train Ops
